what: Once, when a photo frame’s top edge touches the screen center: two pale gray sheets covering the frame fold away in turn around their right edge (1 + 1, power3.in), the top white panel turns transparent from the left with a 110° diagonal gradient (1.5), then the transparent edge pushes out to the right (1.5), and the photo clears from 1.2x scale and 10px blur back to its normal size (2, linear). The whole thing runs at 2.1x speed and ends in about 1.4s — a reveal like a magazine photo being developed

options.speed: Playback speed (timeScale), default 2.1 — 1 keeps the original values as they are, 3s
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo that clears up and shrinks (inside the cell)

from.where: shared.js [data-pp-zoom-img] (article · case photos — original common/scripts zoomImageAnimation)
